params.name: pin_d
params.comment: hinge pin diameter (silver steel / drill blank), 2 to 5 mm

params.name: pin_w0
params.comment: W of the pin's plate end (the first shell knuckle starts here)

params.name: pin_len
params.comment: pin length, first knuckle start to the last knuckle end (W 70 .. 248), 100 to 200 mm

params.name: hinge_x
params.comment: world x of the hinge axis: 0.75 mm outside the back wall (XB - panel_t - 0.75)

params.name: hinge_y
params.comment: world y of the hinge axis: the door split line, PLATE_BOT - panel_t + R_BOTTOM
